title: Changelog
intro: What changed in GlassFolio, release after release.

highlights.smallRefinements: Small refinements across the app and the public site.
highlights.bugFixes: A few bugs fixed for smoother everyday use.

highlights.selfHostVault: Self-hosted Docker edition with local server vault persistence, eliminating browser storage limits while staying 100% offline-first.
highlights.e2eEncryption: Client-side end-to-end encryption (AES-256-GCM) with biometric passkey authentication and automated Google Drive key backup.
highlights.multiAssets: Complete multi-account aggregation across PEA, brokerage CTO, crypto wallets, life insurance, and savings books.
highlights.universalImport: Universal import engine featuring automatic broker format detection, dynamic column mapping, and point-in-time snapshot reconciliation.
highlights.taxReporting: French tax assistant with Cerfa 2042 & 3916-bis simulation, capital gains calculation on PEA withdrawals, and flat-tax vs progressive scale comparison.
highlights.animationHarmonization: Harmonized global animation clock across all dashboard metrics and analytics, instant timeline range switching, and responsive Progress hub navigation.
highlights.assetAllocationExtensible: Extensible asset allocation supporting alternative asset categories with dynamic, theme-stable color generation.
highlights.smartNotifications: Real-time notifications and intelligent alerts center for balance variations, quest achievements, and security events.
highlights.frenchPages: The public site now has its own French pages, at addresses you can share and bookmark.
highlights.findablePublicPages: Public pages now reach search engines complete, with their own title and description, so GlassFolio is easier to find. A full review of how it appears to AI assistants too, with a sitemap for each language.
highlights.taxRates: The tax guide and optimization table show the flat-tax and social contribution rates of each year, with their exceptions.
highlights.consentSwitch: The cookies page has a simple switch to turn audience measurement on or off at any time.
highlights.readability: Better text contrast and larger tap targets on the public site, including on mobile.
highlights.mcpBridge: Connect Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or Antigravity to GlassFolio: they call its tools on your own data through your open, unlocked tab, and every change waits for your approval.
highlights.mcpDocs: A documentation page for the MCP server: how it works, how to connect your AI client, and the list of its 35 tools.
highlights.mcpSetupPrompt: One prompt to copy into Antigravity, Cursor, Claude Code or Codex: it sets up the connection by itself and leaves you two things to paste, the address and the token.
highlights.mcpClientPicker: The MCP settings show one AI client at a time, with its own configuration, and the commands to manage the connection are always in view. Small info bubbles explain why the token is needed and which requests still ask for your confirmation in autonomous mode, a list that updates by itself.
highlights.autonomousMode: A third AI mode, Autonomous: the assistant, a local Ollama model and your AI clients can create and change goals, transactions and alerts without asking you each time. A warning explains the risks before you turn it on.
highlights.contactPage: A contact page that tells you where to write for your data, a bug or a security concern.

v0-4.title: Universal AI MCP Server & Engineering Architecture

highlights.mcpServer: Built-in Universal MCP server exposing portfolio inspection and simulation tools directly to Claude Desktop, Cursor, and external AI agents.
highlights.inAppCopilot: Integrated private AI copilot supporting local Ollama models and private BYOK API keys for instant conversational financial insights.
highlights.productionCore: Overhauled architecture with strict offline-first state boundaries, simulated latency resilience, and full multi-theme support.

v0-3.title: Fee Analysis, Compound Cost Drag & Sector Allocation

highlights.feeAnalysis: Fee breakdown analytics uncovering transaction expenses, management ratios, and long-term compound cost drag against portfolio growth.
highlights.assetComparisons: Multi-series comparison chart tracking your positions against benchmark indexes and risk-free rates with consistent color palettes.
highlights.geographicBreakdown: Sector and geographic diversification breakdown highlighting portfolio exposure and asset concentration risks.

highlights.gamificationHub: Progress and Gamification hub introducing financial experience points (XP), progression levels, and weekly savings consistency streaks.
highlights.achievements: Unlockable financial milestones and badges rewarding disciplined investing, emergency fund constitution, and asset diversification.
highlights.wealthDashboard: Redesigned financial overview dashboard featuring real-time net worth calculation and interactive asset allocation rings.

highlights.corePortfolio: Foundational portfolio tracking engine supporting transactions, realized and unrealized gains, and cash accounts.
highlights.marketPrices: Real-time and historical price tracking for equities, ETFs, and cryptocurrencies with live valuation updates.
highlights.csvImport: CSV transaction import supporting standard broker exports with automated duplicate detection.
